review_candidates.title: Safety Officer
review_candidates.description: Safety Officer – Civil Engineering / Infrastructure Projects A leading civil engineering contractor is seeking a Safety Officer to join their growing team, with the majority of the role based on a major project at Dublin Airport , alongside other civil engineering projects across the Greater Dublin area. This is an excellent opportunity for a Safety Officer with 2–5 years’ experience to develop their career within an established contractor, gaining exposure to large-scale civil, infrastructure, groundworks, and construction projects. The successful candidate will work closely with the Project Manager, Site Management, and wider Health & Safety team to ensure the highest standards of health and safety are maintained across all site activities. Key Responsibilities Implement and monitor the company’s Health & Safety policies and procedures. Carry out regular site inspections, audits, and safety checks. Ensure compliance with relevant health and safety legislation and regulations. Monitor civil, groundworks, excavation, and infrastructure activities. Assist with risk assessments, method statements, and safe systems of work. Investigate incidents, accidents, and near misses and assist with corrective actions. Deliver toolbox talks and site safety briefings. Liaise with site management, subcontractors, and employees on health and safety matters. Maintain accurate health and safety records and documentation. Promote a strong positive safety culture across the project. Assist with safety reporting and ongoing improvements to site safety standards. Requirements Relevant Health & Safety qualification . 2–5 years’ experience in a Health & Safety role within construction or civil engineering. Civil engineering, infrastructure, or groundworks experience is desirable. Strong knowledge of Irish Health & Safety legislation. Experience carrying out site inspections and audits. Good understanding of risk assessments and method statements. Excellent communication and organisational skills. Ability to work effectively with site teams and subcontractors. Full driving licence required. What's on Offer Competitive salary €50,000 – €65,000 DOE . Excellent benefits package. To Apply If you are a Safety Officer with 2–5 years’ experience looking to develop your career within civil engineering and work on major infrastructure projects, please contact Amy Maguire for a confidential discussion or send your CV. Email: a.maguire@gpcireland.com All applications will be treated in the strictest confidence. Your CV will never be submitted to clients without your permission.

review_candidates.title: Responsable de recursos humanos
review_candidates.description: Descripción del Empleo En Todo Rico, empresa paraguaya con amplia trayectoria en el sector gastronómico, buscamos incorporar un/a Jefe/a de Recursos Humanos para liderar integralmente la gestión de personas de nuestras unidades de negocio. La posición tendrá presencia activa en la operación, acompañando tanto a los equipos de producción y elaboración de alimentos como al personal de locales, catering, servicios y áreas administrativas. Buscamos una persona con experiencia comprobable en empresas gastronómicas, de alimentos, consumo masivo, retail gastronómico o cadenas de locales, que comprenda la dinámica del trabajo operativo, los turnos, la atención al cliente y las exigencias propias del rubro. Propósito del cargo Liderar la gestión integral de Recursos Humanos, asegurando la disponibilidad, organización, desarrollo y correcta administración de las personas que forman parte de Todo Rico. El cargo deberá acompañar de cerca la operación, fortalecer el liderazgo de encargados y supervisores, asegurar el cumplimiento laboral y contribuir a construir equipos comprometidos, productivos y alineados con la cultura de la empresa. Principales responsabilidades Liderar la gestión de Recursos Humanos de producción, locales, catering, servicios y áreas administrativas. Mantener presencia activa en los distintos espacios de trabajo, comprendiendo las necesidades reales de cada operación. Acompañar y fortalecer la gestión de encargados de locales, supervisores, jefaturas y responsables operativos. Planificar las necesidades de personal de acuerdo con el volumen de producción, funcionamiento de los locales, eventos y temporadas de mayor demanda. Liderar los procesos de reclutamiento, selección, contratación e inducción de personal operativo, técnico, administrativo y de liderazgo. Gestionar búsquedas masivas y coberturas ágiles para posiciones de alta rotación. Supervisar la elaboración y control de nómina, marcaciones, horarios, turnos, horas extras, vacaciones, permisos, ausencias y legajos. Asegurar la correcta aplicación de salarios, beneficios, bonificaciones y obligaciones laborales. Garantizar el cumplimiento de la legislación laboral paraguaya, políticas internas y procedimientos de la empresa. Gestionar medidas disciplinarias, llamados de atención, desvinculaciones y documentación laboral. Intervenir de manera oportuna en conflictos laborales y situaciones que puedan afectar el clima o la continuidad de la operación. Implementar procesos de evaluación de desempeño, capacitación, desarrollo y formación de líderes operativos. Promover una cultura de servicio, disciplina operativa, compromiso, respeto, trabajo en equipo y orientación al cliente. Desarrollar acciones de comunicación interna y reconocimiento. Elaborar y dar seguimiento al presupuesto del área de Recursos Humanos. Presentar indicadores e información de gestión para facilitar la toma de decisiones de la Gerencia. Perfil requerido Formación universitaria en Psicología Laboral, Recursos Humanos, Administración de Empresas o carreras afines. Experiencia mínima de 4 años en posiciones generalistas de Recursos Humanos. Al menos 2 años coordinando o liderando equipos, procesos o áreas de RRHH. Experiencia reciente y comprobable en empresas gastronómicas, producción de alimentos, consumo masivo, catering, hotelería, supermercados o cadenas de locales. Experiencia trabajando directamente con personal operativo, encargados, supervisores y jefaturas. Manejo integral de nómina, administración de personal y legislación laboral paraguaya. Experiencia en contratación operativa y procesos de selección de volumen. Conocimiento de sistemas de marcación, control de asistencia y herramientas de gestión de Recursos Humanos. Manejo de Excel y elaboración de indicadores. Disponibilidad para recorrer la planta, los locales y las diferentes unidades operativas. Disponibilidad para responder a las necesidades propias de una operación gastronómica con horarios y turnos diversos. Manejo de la IA. Competencias clave Liderazgo cercano y firme. Alta capacidad de ejecución. Organización y seguimiento. Criterio para tomar decisiones. Capacidad para trabajar bajo presión. Resolución práctica de conflictos. Comunicación clara y directa. Confidencialidad y madurez profesional. Orientación a resultados y al servicio. Flexibilidad para desenvolverse en una operación dinámica. Capacidad para relacionarse con diferentes niveles de la organización. Requisitos excluyentes Experiencia directa en el rubro gastronómico, alimenticio, consumo masivo, retail, hotelería o cadenas de locales. Experiencia comprobable con personal operativo y operaciones por turnos. Dominio de administración de personal, nómina y legislación laboral paraguaya. Disponibilidad para trabajar presencialmente y acompañar activamente la operación. #lambare #Asuncion #recursoshumanospy

Who We Are Emerald Clinical Trials is a global leader in clinical research, partnering with over 160 biotech companies and 15 of the world’s top 20 pharmaceutical firms. Headquartered in Singapore, we combine scientific excellence with operational expertise to deliver end-to-end clinical trial solutions across all phases, offering Phase I-IV and real-world studies . With over 25 years of experience and a world-renowned focus in renal research , Emerald Clinical has helped drive medical breakthroughs through deep scientific insight, flawless execution, and an unwavering commitment to quality. Global Expertise. Local Insight. Real Impact. Emerald Clinical is where science, speed, and strategy come together to transform healthcare. For over 25 years, we have led the way in clinical research, combining global reach with deep Asia-Pacific expertise and unparalleled local insight to deliver smarter trials and stronger outcomes. Our 1000+ employees that span across Asia-Pacific, Europe, and the Americas are embedded in communities worldwide. We drive faster recruitment, deeper patient engagement, and meaningful results that move medicine forward. About The Role We are seeking a highly organised and proactive Project Specialist to join our Early Phase Project Management team. This role provides full-time support to our Project Managers in Early Phase team, contributing directly to the delivery and coordination of global clinical trials. You will be allocated to studies and play an essential role in ensuring timelines, deliverables, and quality standards are met. Your Responsibilities Provide day-to-day operational and administrative support to Project Managers in Early Phase team. Manage study documentation and maintain project trackers and systems Coordinate internal and external project meetings, including scheduling, agendas, and meeting minutes Follow up on action items and deliverables with cross-functional teams and vendors Support communications with clinical sites, vendors, and internal teams as needed Contribute to key trial activities such as study start-up, maintenance, and close-out Ensure all activities comply with SOPs, ICH-GCP guidelines, and regulatory standards Co-coordinated meetings, prepared meeting minutes for internal and external stakeholders (Especially for Client meetings, cross functional internal team meetings, Vendor meetings, etc) Assisted team in managing study and site budget (esp Investigator site payments, Vendor payments, Payment tracking, etc) Used or have good knowledge of Project Management systems, like CTMS, Financial and resource planning, etc Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint); Knowledge of MS projects is plus (this can be learned as well) About You To be successful in this role, you will have: Bachelor's degree in Life Sciences, Pharmacy, Nursing, or a related field 2–3 years in clinical research, with a focus on trial coordination and project support. Previous experience supporting clinical trials within a CRO, sponsor, or similar environment Understand Clinical trial stages or worked from start to end of clinical trial Familiarity with clinical trial documentation, processes, and regulations (e.g., ICH-GCP) Comfortable working with Microsoft Office and clinical systems (e.g., CTMS, eTMF) Strong organisational skills with the ability to prioritise and manage multiple tasks Excellent verbal and written communication skills Proactive, detail-oriented, and a team player Why Join Us? At our core, Emerald Clinical Trials is committed to transforming clinical research by putting people first—both patients and our employees. By joining our team, you’ll be part of a global network of passionate professionals working together to deliver better research and outcomes for millions worldwide. Here’s What Makes Us Stand Out Purpose-Driven Work: You’ll contribute to clinical trials that genuinely improve lives, with a focus on therapies in renal, cardiometabolic, and oncology. Global Reach, Local Expertise: Our teams connect with local communities, building trust and meaningful engagement for every trial. Collaboration and Innovation: Work in a culture that values diverse perspectives and creative solutions to solve global health challenges. What We Offer We understand that great work happens when people feel valued and supported. That’s why we provide: Competitive Compensation: A tailored salary and benefits package to reflect your skills and experience. Flexibility: Enjoy hybrid or remote working arrangements, depending on your location and role. Career Growth: Access to a wealth of learning opportunities and a global network of scientific leaders to help you grow and develop in your role. Employee Wellbeing: Participate in programs and initiatives designed to promote work-life balance, health, and team connection, including global engagement surveys, recognition programs, and team-building events. Global Opportunities: Be part of a company with international reach, offering you exposure to diverse projects and clients. Interested? Apply now and help us achieve our mission to improve the health of millions worldwide. We are an equal-opportunity employer and encourage applications from all qualified candidates.

review_candidates.title: Programme de début de carrière Hexcel : un(e) Ingénieur(e) Conception Mécanique F/H
review_candidates.description: Grâce à son solide investissement dans la recherche et le développement et sa culture de l'amélioration continue, Hexcel est le leader industriel dans le domaine de la fabrication des composites hautes performances : fibres de carbone, tissus techniques, résines, préimprégnés, nids d’abeille, pièces de fabrication additive. Nous vous invitons à rejoindre l’équipe Hexcel au sein de ses différents sites de fabrication, bureaux commerciaux ou centres de R&T partout dans le monde. Devenez un acteur de notre « strength within ». Dans le cadre de son programme de début de carrière (ECP) , Hexcel recrute un(e) Ingénieur(e) Conception Mécanique F/H en CDI pour intégrer le site des Avenières (350 collaborateurs) à proximité de Chambéry. Intégré(e) au sein du service R&T dans l’équipe de développement process d’une quinzaine de personnes, vous participerez aux projets de création et/ou d’amélioration de moyens de production de matériaux renforts innovants. Le programme Hexcel de début de carrière est un programme sur deux ans, au cours duquel les participants ont l'opportunité d'acquérir une grande expérience et de découvrir les différentes fonctions de l'entreprise Hexcel.
